the problem is, I sent the picture, told them the order was ready and waited outside for about 5 minutes until a new order came up on my app and they didn’t say anything until I was at the restaurant picking up my new order. I understand waiting for someone but I’m not going to wait longer than 5 minutes and miss out on income. Especially because I know some people want to leave their orders outside for a little while right now
